Calcula tu crédito automotriz

Calcula el Costo Anual Total (CAT) de tu crédito automotriz a partir de la mensualidad, o la mensualidad a partir de la tasa anual. La calculadora suma el IVA del 16% sobre los intereses y calcula el CAT sin IVA, como lo exige Banxico.

La calculadora está en inglés; tu navegador puede traducirla al español con un clic.

Car APR calculator in Mexican pesos

This car loan calculator works in Mexican pesos (MXN, $). Enter the car price, down payment, term and monthly payment in Mexican pesos to find the real interest rate, or enter a rate to get the monthly payment and total interest. It is not a currency converter: every amount stays in Mexican pesos, and the math follows the loan rules in Mexico, including the CAT (Costo Anual Total) that lenders there must show.

Worked example: a typical car loan in Mexico

A MX$350,000 car with MX$70,000 down leaves MX$280,000 to finance. Over 48 months at 14% a year (tasa anual sin IVA), the monthly payment is MX$7,969.74 and the total interest including IVA is MX$102,547. As a nominal rate that is 14.00% a year; as an effective rate, 14.93%.

The 16% IVA on the interest is why the payment is MX$7,969.74 and not MX$7,651.41: it adds MX$15,280 over the loan. The CAT for this loan without fees is 14.93%, calculated without IVA as Banxico requires.

These are example figures for a typical loan. Enter your own numbers in the calculator above.

Car loan rules in Mexico

  • Lenders advertise a nominal annual rate (tasa anual sin IVA) and must also show the CAT, an all-in effective annual cost including fees and insurance, calculated without IVA (Banxico).
  • IVA of 16% is charged on the interest of car loans to individuals, so your actual payment is higher than the rate alone suggests. The calculator adds it to the payment and leaves it out of the CAT, as the law requires.
  • Banks must accept early payments on consumer credit when you are up to date and apply them to the principal (Banxico Circular 16/2007), and in practice there is no penalty.

Sources: Banxico: what is the CAT · Banxico Circular 16/2007. Rules checked October 2026.

How to use this calculator

Choose Find my CAT and enter the price, your down payment, the term and the monthly payment from your offer. The calculator works backward to the CAT that lenders in Mexico must disclose, and shows the same loan as a nominal rate and an effective rate. Choose Find my payment to turn a quoted rate into a monthly payment. All figures are in MXN and you can switch country at the top of the page.

Frequently asked questions

Can I calculate car loan APR in Mexican pesos?

Yes. This page works entirely in Mexican pesos (MXN, $). Amounts are not converted from dollars; the calculator uses Mexico loan rules and shows results in Mexican pesos.

What is the CAT?

The Costo Anual Total is the all-in effective annual cost of a loan, including fees and insurance, calculated without IVA as Banxico requires.

Can I pay my car loan early in Mexico?

Yes. Banks must accept early payments when you are up to date and apply them to the principal, and in practice there is no penalty.

¿Qué es el CAT?

El Costo Anual Total es el costo efectivo anual del crédito, incluyendo intereses, comisiones y seguros, calculado sin IVA. Sirve para comparar créditos.

¿Se cobra IVA en un crédito automotriz?

Sí. A las personas físicas se les cobra 16% de IVA sobre los intereses, por eso la mensualidad es mayor de lo que indica la tasa.
